item.title: Saudi Arabia and Portugal Strengthen Healthcare Cooperation During Ministerial Visit
item.description:
Saudi Arabia and Portugal Strengthen Healthcare Cooperation During Ministerial Visit

Saudi Arabia’s Health Minister, Fahad Al-Jalajel, has begun an official visit to Portugal aimed at strengthening bilateral healthcare cooperation. The visit focuses on expanding relations, exchanging expertise, and exploring collaborative opportunities across the health sector.

🔍 Overview

During the official visit, Minister Al-Jalajel is scheduled to meet with senior officials and representatives from Portugal’s health sector. These meetings are designed to examine how closer cooperation and knowledge sharing can support the development of health systems, services, and innovation in both Saudi Arabia and Portugal.

⚙️ Key Focus Areas

The bilateral exchange centers on several main elements:

  • Healthcare Transformation: A key focus is Saudi Arabia’s ongoing healthcare transformation, with the Saudi delegation highlighting progress and lessons learned from their system’s development.
  • Knowledge and Expertise Sharing: The exchange is intended to facilitate the transfer of knowledge and identify areas of mutual interest to build stronger health systems.
  • Portuguese Insights: The Saudi delegation aims to learn about Portuguese approaches to healthcare delivery, system development, and innovation.
  • Institutional Collaboration: By engaging health authorities and sector leaders, both nations seek to establish practical opportunities for collaboration and strengthen institutional links.

💡 Why It Matters

This visit underscores the rising importance of international partnerships in addressing the changing demands of modern healthcare systems. Through these discussions, both nations seek to:

  • Improve healthcare service delivery and encourage innovation.
  • Strengthen the overall efficiency and resilience of their health sectors.
  • Provide Saudi Arabia with opportunities to exchange experiences regarding healthcare transformation.
  • Enable Portugal to build on its relationship with Saudi Arabia and explore cooperative efforts that support shared interests.

#SaudiArabia #Portugal #Healthcare #BilateralRelations #HealthInnovation

Source: Saudi Arabia Portugal Healthcare Cooperation Expands During Ministerial Visit

item.title: MobiCHAI’3 Workshop Focuses on Trustworthy AI for Cognitive Support
item.description:
MobiCHAI’3 Workshop Focuses on Trustworthy AI for Cognitive Support

The ACM International Conference on Mobile Human-Computer Interaction 2026 will host the 3rd International Workshop on Mobile Cognition-Altering and Cognitive-Augmenting Technologies using Human-Centered AI (mobiCHAI’3).

🔍 Overview

  • MobiCHAI’3 is the third edition of the International Workshop on Mobile Cognition-Altering/Augmenting Technologies (CAT) Using Human-Centered AI.
  • The workshop follows two successful events in 2024 and 2025.
  • Organizers include Agnes Gruenerbl, Jan Spilski, Paul Lukowicz, and Thomas Lachmann, all affiliated with institutions in Kaiserslautern, Germany.

⚙️ Key details

  • The focus has shifted from exploring the design space to trustworthy, mission-oriented, and domain-specific mobile and wearable AI systems for cognitive support in real-world contexts.
  • Key domains include healthcare and other high-stakes areas, such as:
    • Support for surgical preparation and perioperative procedures
    • Monitoring of stress and workload
    • Cognitive assistance for clinicians and care teams
  • Special attention is given to trust calibration in AI-supported decision-making.
  • Contributions are welcome from education, work, accessibility, well-being, and everyday life.

🧩 Topics

  • Multimodal sensing of cognitive and affective states
  • Human-centered modeling and simulation of cognition
  • Methods of cognitive augmentation
  • Ethical, social, and trust-related implications

🎓 Audience

  • The conference addresses an interdisciplinary community spanning:
    • Mobile HCI
    • Ubiquitous Computing
    • Cognitive Science
    • Healthcare
    • AI
    • Design Research
    • Social Sciences

#AI #MobileHCI #CognitiveAugmentation #HumanCenteredAI #Healthcare #TrustworthyAI

Source: Program at a Glance - MobileHCI 2026

item.title: AI Detects Heart Disease in Women Through Mammograms
item.description:
AI Detects Heart Disease in Women Through Mammograms

A new study suggests that artificial intelligence (AI) can identify heart disease in women by analysing mammogram images.

🔍 Overview

  • AI can detect heart disease in women using mammograms, study suggests.

⚙️ Key details

  • The capability is demonstrated in a research study.
  • It targets female patients.
  • The analysis is performed on existing mammogram scans.

💡 Why it matters

  • Provides a potential method for early heart disease detection in women.
  • Utilises imaging already performed for breast cancer screening, offering additional health insights without extra procedures.

#AI #Healthcare #WomenHealth #MedicalAI
